build_learner: build an IMPALA Learner instance with an agent, optimizer, batch size, and discount factor
run_learner: run the IMPALA Learner for a specified number of training iterations with logging
compute_policy_gradient_loss: compute the summed policy gradient loss for [T, B, ...] shaped logits using rlax
compute_entropy_loss: compute the summed entropy loss for [T, B, ...] shaped logits using rlax
enqueue_trajectory: enqueue a trajectory transition into the learner's host queue for batch processing
